name: What are the common benefits of adding a Junior ADU to my property?

mainEntity.name: What are the common benefits of adding a Junior ADU to my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a Junior ADU can provide significant advantages, such as generating rental income, housing family members, or creating a dedicated home office or guest suite. This type of renovation enhances the functionality and value of your property without requiring new construction on your lot. When considering a JADU, it's important to evaluate your household's long-term needs and how the new space will contribute to your lifestyle, as this will influence design choices and feature priorities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include potential rental income, housing for family, or a dedicated workspace, enhancing property value and functionality.
